decision_conditions: The proposed rear and front dormers by reason of their design, siting and scale, would represent an overly dominant and incongruous form of development that would erode the original appearance of the host property and result in harm to the character of the Conservation Area. The scheme would cause less than substantial harm to the CA76 Madrid Road Conservation Area, and there are considered to be no public benefits to outweigh this harm. As such, the proposal would be contrary to the NPPF, and the London Borough of Richmond upon Thames Local Plan (2025), in particular policies 28 & 29, as supported by the CA76 Madrid Road Conservation Area Statement and study as well as the House Extensions and External Alterations SPD.
description: Single storey ground floor extension and side return with the installation of 4 rooflights.  Modification of the roof form to include a front and rear dormer with the installation of two rooflights to the front roof slope and one to the rear dormer. New parapet wall built to mirror existing on the other side to enclose the rear dormer
